fact: Morocco's Interior Minister states, in a written parliamentary answer, that the integrated revenue management system GIR-CT is generalised to local authorities through circular 9229 of 1 July 2020 and issues electronic receipts, and that an electronic platform for declaring and paying local taxes is in service.
title: منصات إلكترونية وأنظمة مندمجة.. الداخلية تخطط لإنهاء التدبير التقليدي لجبايات الجماعات
